title: Continuous cochains from finite quotients with varying coefficients
statement:
Let $G$ be a profinite group (a compact Hausdorff topological group with a neighbourhood basis at the identity consisting of open normal subgroups), and let $U_0\supseteq U_1\supseteq\cdots$ be open normal subgroups cofinal among the open normal subgroups of $G$. Set $Q_r=G/U_r$. Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. For every $r\geq0$ let $N_r$ be an $A$-module with an $A$-linear $Q_r$-action. Suppose given $A$-linear transition maps $f_{sr}:N_r\to N_s$ for $s\geq r$, satisfying $f_{rr}=1$, $f_{ts}f_{sr}=f_{tr}$ and $f_{sr}(\bar g_r n)=\bar g_s f_{sr}(n)$ for every $g\in G$. No injectivity of $f_{sr}$ is assumed. Let $N=\varinjlim_rN_r$, with its induced $G$-action and the discrete topology; every element is fixed by some $U_r$, so this is a discrete continuous module [def-exc-continuous-cohomology]. Write $C^a(Q_r,N_r)=\operatorname{Map}(Q_r^a,N_r)$ with the usual inhomogeneous group differential, and $C^a_{\mathrm{cont}}(G,N)=\operatorname{Cont}(G^a,N)$ with the same differential [lem-exc-cochains-derived-invariants]. The transition cochain map sends $c$ to $(\bar g_{1,s},\ldots,\bar g_{a,s})\mapsto f_{sr}(c(\bar g_{1,r},\ldots,\bar g_{a,r}))$. Inflation followed by the coefficient maps induces a natural isomorphism of cochain complexes of $A$-modules
$$\varinjlim_r C^\bullet(Q_r,N_r)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }C^\bullet_{\mathrm{cont}}(G,N).$$
In degree $a$ the isomorphism sends the class of $c$ to $(g_1,\ldots,g_a)\mapsto[c(\bar g_{1,r},\ldots,\bar g_{a,r})]$.
